notes.title: The Collar Release Notes - v2.0.0
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=c4DmPLkCW4c;full][/previewyoutube]
Update 1
I am very excited to bring you Update 1 or v2.0.0 of The Collar. I have worked hard to make sure I deliver a quality game that keeps pushing this experience further each time. I hope everyone enjoys all the additions, new areas to find surprises, new ways to eliminate other players, and some bug fixes sprinkled in. My roadmap is big and long and this is the start of a long journey. I will keep bringing even more laughter and fun to you and your foes! Hope to see you in an experiment!

~The Collar is bigger and better.

New Features
Players

 Allow free look when long interacting, healing bleeds, and being trapped
 Players can now randomly fall on slippery surfaces like ice and polished floors
 Added a squeaky floor sound when running on the freshly polished floors that are slippery
 Updated slippery surfaces friction to feel more real
 Fixed squeaky floor sound effect to be more realistic Players can now be knocked down when being hit hard enough in the head, in the body with certain weapons, and weapon sweeps to the legs
 Players who perform a knock down hit use more stamina and as a player is getting up they will take less damage
 Players have red blood and Bots have black blood
 Characters handle different color blood on player splatter
 Weapons handle different color blood on weapon splatter
 Fixed an issue with the blood color not changing for characters and their blood splatters across all playersWeapons

 New Weapon: Energy Drink and a Drink Machine for vending
The energy drink machines will allow players to vend an energy drink. Each energy drink machine can dispense a limited number of energy drinks. This energy drink is a useful weapon that hits very hard. The energy drink has a limited number of hits before it will explode so be careful throwing and swinging it around. The energy drink machines can be found on The Parking Garage and The Train Station.
 Added new achievements for the new weapons
 Added new stats for the the new weapons
 Branches and energy drinks are both breakable weapons and are limited use
Environment Weapons
Each environment weapon has different properties and cause damage in different ways. The damage is very hurtful to any player who gets caught in the damage wake from low stamina, the inability to run, slow limping, and even bleeding. These can be very immobilizing so be careful or be very clever in their use as some are one time use and others can be used multiple times. When close, these will glow white so players know they are able to interact with them.

 The Bear Trap
The bear trap has multiple states, unset, set, trapped, and back to unset. Setting a trap is as easy as finding one, and setting it. Once any player, that includes the player who set the trap, hits a set trap, they will be trapped until they release themselves. They will be bleeding and the players body will have difficulty moving. Both of which will need to be remedied. Once a trap is released, after a random amount of time, it can be reset for the next the victim. Set bear traps can be sprung with any weapon thrown at it. The bear traps are randomly scattered on The Winter Forest.
 The Fire Extinguisher
Fire extinguishers can be hit with a axe, baseball bat, or crowbar causing the tank to rupture. This will cause a dangerously cold gas to be released very rapidly into the surrounding air causing frost bite on players skin and in their lungs. It will take time for the players lungs to recover. The fire extinguishers can be found on The Parking Garage and The Warehouse.
 The Gas Tank & The Radioactive Oxygen Tank
These tanks have a loose release valve and hitting them or throwing something hard at them will cause the valve to break. Once broken the tank will release a noxious gas into the air around them for a time. It is very difficult to breath causing coughing and damage to the lungs. It will take time for the players lungs to recover. The gas tanks can be found on The Abandoned Factory. The radioactive oxygen tanks can be found on The Waste Pit.
 The Generator and Electrified Metal
The generators have a sensitive safety fuse which can be tripped very easily with something thrown at them. Once they are tripped, all the lights turn off and most metal gets an electric arc that causes it to be electrified. The hum of electric current will be heard whilst it is dangerous and will cause a nasty electric shock and burn if touched. If electrocuted it takes time for the players body to recover. After the safety fuse resets, it will take time for the lights to come back on and for the safety fuse to be able to be disrupted again. The generators can be found on The Industrial Park.
 Added white glow on environment weapons within a radius so players know they can interact with them
 Added stamina and movement disabilities when hurt by environment weaponsWorld

 CFT will now be randomly positioned on the level at the start of each level
 Fixed an issue with the CFT not be positioned correctly for all players after random placing it at the start of a level

Updates
Players

 Updated collar lighting brightness down by 120% to not have over-glow and bloom blowout across all levels
 Updated weapon swing speed to be 25% faster when stamina is above 25%
 Updated vocal sound when you slip and fall
 Updated crouching to happen much quicker
 Updated long interaction to happen more quickly now
 Updated to make player face interactable item before using it
 Updated weapon throwing to make it more accurate
World

 Updated destructible system for performance and future expansions
 Updated destruction system to give player damage, but also allow different types of damage inflicted upon the destructible item
 Updated environment triggers to be able to move after playing
 Updated the metal gates to be consistent across each level
 Updated the CFT to have more options for future expansions
 Updated skies for more natural star shine when sun is setting or rising
Audio

 Updated the number of audio channels from 32 to 64
UI

 Updated message after clicking the "Back to waiting room" button so it is not just hanging there before the load starts
 Updated Overall stats layout and look
 Updated How To Play overall
 Updated How To Play on environment weapons to be more clear
 Updated map images with the new map light builds
 Updated translations
 Updated credits including the timing on the initial scroll
 Updated default input to be set to mouse and keyboard
 Updated Beta games so the stats do overwrite the release stats
 Updated Beta games so no achievements get calculated

Bug Fixes
Players

 Fixed an issue that played animation when player could not move
 Fixed an issue that allowed players to crouch, jump, or attack whilst doing other actions
 Fixed an issue with the turn animation making it smoother and less stuttery
 Fixed an issue with long interaction from getting stuck with a quick on/off action
 Fixed an issue causing the last attacker to not get the kill if player dies from falling or bleeding
 Fixed an issue when everyone dies, regardless of how, stats are given and reported correctly
 Fixed an issue with collisions not being consistent across all players
 Fixed an issue where players would keep taking damage after the round was overWeapons

 Fixed an issue with the weapon highlight colors if highlighted when collar changes
 Fixed an issue with the broken branch 3 not having physics on
 Fixed an issue with the color variation on the weapons for moss as it had blue set to 1 instead of 0
 Fixed an issue that was destroying the projectiles early
 Fixed an issue when a breakable weapon breaks that would not drop broken weaponEnvironment Weapons

 Fixed energy drink texture
 Fixed drink machine size
 Fixed an issue with the electric collisions
 Fixed an issue with the textures on the fire extinguisherWorld

 Fixed an issue with the environment trigger not being consistent for all players
 Fixed an issue with the environment trigger not playing audio for all players
 Fixed an issue with the environment trigger audio and particles not looping correctly
 Fixed an issue that right after a player activates the CFT, if you kill the player that activated it, the CFT fails to fire
 Fixed an issue with the CFT panels not activating
 Fixed an issue with the CFT causing the tips to show for everyone
 Fixed an issue with the CFT playing audio on the wrong channel
 Fixed an issue with the destruction system spawning particle debris and playing sounds correctly for all players
 Fixed an issue with non-blocking destructible items stopping sliding
UI

 Fixed an issue not allowing ESC to work on the lobby menu
 Fixed an issue with the Pirate translations
 Fixed an issue causing the interaction text from showing the correct key or keypad prompt
 Fixed an issue with the name for branch was still Stick after it was switched to Branch
 Fixed an issue that was not counting the top kills correctly
 Fixed an issue where players dying from falling or escaping would cause status to be recorded as a survival
 Fixed an issue causing the round stats to report death by melee even when still alive
 Fixed an issue with overall results UI and made it more clear
 Fixed an issue with the Round stats UI
 Fixed an issue with padding on the UI stats
 Fixed an issue with the save game file

Bots
New Features

 Bots now evade attacks better which includes dodging and crouching (self-learned skilled)
 Bots now climb on any climbable (self-learned skilled)
Updates

 Updated melee attack range
 Updated bots when running away so they are not quite so dumb
 Removed bots climbing links as they are no longer needed
Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue that would cause bots to not run away if hit too many times and thus failing to protect themselves
 Fixed an issue with bots causing errors with no post processing materials

Maps
New Maps

 The Cemetery
The cold rain floods a somber place with its cool water and heart crackling thunder. The world around you is soaked with fear and loss. Each tomb represents one or more loses, standing above the ground for all to see. The cool breeze riddles through your wetness and sends a shiver up your spine…or perhaps it is just the dead. Find yourself weaving in and out of those lost before you in a maze of hide-n-seek. Careful though as you run and hide, there may be someone or something waiting for you. Do you find your way out? Or did you find your own tomb?
 The Parking Garage
The sun glimpses the edge of that moment of calm and serenity before the hustle and bustle fills the air of sound and smell of the city, the birds, and the people, starting to wake from their slumber. Protected by the solid walls of drab concrete and steel, sits the cars as the vessels for destinations from the journeys to come. As the cars sit waiting, you are not as lucky, as waiting may end your journey and there are levels of opportunity all around you. As you go up and down, each level provides a new opportunity. Does it end with you on top? Or do these walls park you in your final destination.
 The Train Station
The evening has descended onto the world. As the need to be able to take more of you to those far off places grows, a new station blossoms. Other operational stations rumble all around, as the darkness overtakes this one for the last time with the glow of its awaiting maiden voyage breaking through. Three trains prepared for the new adventures await in this uneasy calm. Three sleeping giants ready to burst into the world. Adventure is just the beginning for you, however, who have found this calm. And if not careful, you shall find a calm that lasts for eternity.New Features

 Added random locations for the CFT
Updates

 Updated audio triggers
 Updated metal gates
 Updated weapons
Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue causing the particle systems to be included in localizations
Performance

 Optimized memory usage on all maps
 Optimized fps on all maps
 Adjusted scene lighting to match across all maps
 Adjusted bloom and cleaned up warnings
 Simplified all shaders
 Regenerated all shaders
 Rebuilt all lighting
 Regenerated navigation

The Cemetery
Updates

 Fixed an issue causing the level to crashThe Industrial Park

Updates

Bug Fixes

Performance

The Lost Ruins
Updates

Bug Fixes

Performance

Updates

 Updated car alarms audio to be balanced
 Updated the car alarms to only work when you hit or slide or climb on them
 Updated cars to not be able to climb on cars except for truck beds
 Updated car alarms to only go off for 15 seconds instead of 30
 Updated parking barriers to have collision on the arm while moving down so it automatically goes back up
 Updated bots to avoid the cars as much as possibleBug Fixes

 Fixed an issue with the car alarm attenuation
 Fixed an issue with the truck bed car alarm trigger
 Fixed an issue with the CFT clipping through the floors
 Fixed an issue with the car alarms being consistent with all players
 Fixed an issue with visible collisions on some meshes
 Fixed an issue with mesh collisionsThe Train Station
Updates

 Updated squeaky floor audio
 Updated collision on benches
 Updated wet reflective shaderBug Fixes

 Fixed an issue with the lighting in the tunnel
 Fixed an issue with bots getting stuck by the passenger gates
The Tropical Forest
Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue with the howler monkey audio and particles
 Fixed an issue with a floating vine
Performance

 Optimized the river
 Optimized the waterfall
The Warehouse
New Features

 Added environment weapon fire extinguishers
Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue with the plastic bottle shaders
 Fixed an issue with the pushcarts
 Fixed an issue with the fire extinguishers not being consistent for all players

Performance

The Waste Pit
New Features

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue with the cabin door becoming desync'd when opening and closing
 Fixed an issue with the cabin door showing interaction text even though players cannot interact with it
Performance

 Optimized cabin windows

Performance

 Changed all metal gates to be static instead of movable

 Performance update on the collar color logic

 Optimizations to the C++ solution

notes.title: The Collar: Update 1 (Trailer)
notes.content:
The first of many updates to The Collar. It has been 1 year since the release and this is a full update of new maps, new mechanics, faster gameplay, bug fixes, performance enhancements, and much, much more!

I am REALLY close to releasing this update. I am in the finalizing and hardening stages of the code. I am checking and double checking everything so the Update can go as smooth as possible. The release notes will be posted BEFORE the Update is live so everyone knows what is coming. Enjoy the trailer!

~The Collar has updates.

notes.title: New Year, New Update
notes.content:
New year. New Update. That is right folks the time is at hand! Update 1 is right around the corner and I am excited to share a PREVIEW of what is coming. New maps. New environment weapons to spice up game play. New weapons. Plus many, many fixes and updates to keep this game moving forward! Not everything is listed here (you will have to wait for the release notes) but this gives you a taste of some of the big changes.

I look forward to getting to play and laugh with as many of you as I can! You are all so amazing and I cannot thank you enough for being a part of this awesome community we have created. I am on the cusp of release so keep your eyes peeled!

~The Collar is preparing to kill you in new ways.

notes.title: December Update
notes.content:
Yeah I know it is a little late but I have been heads down for so many hours I forgot to do this months update. I HAD to get it in before the holidays were over and folks thought I had forgotten about them!

For the last month quite a few new changes have come about. Some redesigns have happened. New interactions in the levels. A whole lot of awesomeness for everyone to play with! There have been a couple successful smoke testing and only a couple of bugs found; all have been fixed and updated mind you. And of course preparing for the all new items, new levels, and new mechanics being added for this Update it will feel like a new game!

I wish everyone happy holidays and know that I am working very hard to get this released as soon as possible, but know this, I refuse to put out a update without thoroughly investing testing and bug catching time. I am not perfect, but will do my best to make sure it is the top level quality. That has always been my promise to you and I stand by it.

Now go eat and be merry and enjoy your holidays with family or friends...and if not, please know you have a community of The Collar that is always here for you! I appreciate this crazy whirlwind of a year with all of you and that you have chosen to be a part of this community. Game on and hope to see you in an experiment!

Happy Holidays and see you all in 2025!!!!

~The Collar is on the naughty list and doesn't care.

notes.title: November Update
notes.content:
Another month. Another spooky season. Another fall is upon us. It has been flying by so quickly. Quickly enough it is hard to keep up and be able to finish everything as quickly as I want. Yes I am talking Update 1. I am very close, but golly it feels like there is not enough time in the month...or day...or the hour...LOL

Nonetheless...the first beta was released in a super-secret-rainbow-butterfly-unicorn-kitten branch. This means I am close to opening things up to the testers. I have done many...many...MANY smoke tests with Update 1 to ensure the best goes out with as few possibilities for bugs to arise as best I can. I am not perfect, but I want to make sure thoroughness of Update 1. I did one special quick beta test with one of our testers (thank you BTW) and things seemed very well so that is the good news.

The other side is not necessarily sad or bad news, but more just news on where I am at on Update 1. All the new mechanics are done. The new maps look and work great. All the shader performance updates are magical and you can tell a difference. With all that being said, there are a couple of issues that came out of the single beta test run we did; none of them are major, but need to be fixed to ensure the best experience for you. There also came a small tweak on one of the new mechanics that I feel will help you enjoy said mechanic better. Yes I am being vague on purpose because I do not want to give too much away until the actual release.

I am close to a posting a release date. I want to make sure I hit the date and would hate to lead anyone astray or have to push it back or push a product less than stellar just to meet said date. In other words, I am not done yet! :)

I saw some new players join the experiments over the spooky season. I even got to play with some old and new players and it was a laugh fest as always! I am so glad everyone is having so much fun with the game. I even saw some new achievements unlocked (even some hidden ones) recently so congratulations on those unlocks! I hope to see more playtime and folks still enjoying the gameplay and know that things are coming, to change some tactics and ways of playing, very soon. Stay strong and get out there and give The Collar something to write about!

~The Collar is sifting though lots of trial results and is very happy.

notes.title: October Update
notes.content:
The leaves are getting crispy, colorful, and falling under our feet. To give away our position.

The cool wind is bringing the chill we all know and love. Or is that death.

Three new levels, a bunch of new mechanics, some surprises, and some new achievements await our next Update together! I have been doing some finishing touches on the new and shining up some of the old with some new improvements both performant and visual. Still more work to be done, but testing time is upon us. Keep watching for announcements...they are coming!

~The Collar hates pumpkin spice.

notes.title: Septemeber Update
notes.content:
Great things have happened for this month and that means we are closer to releasing Update 1! With all the work done on the 3 new levels, I am moving forward to focusing on performance improvements, bugs, and a couple of new mechanic polishing. We should be starting some testing groups soon to get a feel for items that still need to be worked on. I hope you are continue to get those skills up because there will be new challenges coming with this update and it will be a new level of competition. Hop into Discord and see if anyone is looking for a game and in the meantime, play away and practice up!

~The Collar is getting bigger.

notes.title: August Update
notes.content:
Well another month has rolled by and lots of work has been completed and more has begun. The second Level, the Parking Garage, has been completed, optimized, and will be playable in the next update. Soon we will have some Alpha Testers playing it to make sure you do not get caught inside a car or fall off the map...cause...well...it happens.

There has been early development in some new items that will help the player and not just used to hit things. Keep an eye out for that in this update too.

As to the current work being done, the third level has been started and laid out. The images are a VERY early work in progress but gives you a tease what it is. Things are progressing but the details are important and I strive to make the levels great and not just throw assets in it. Keep watching for more updates and keep on enjoying the game!

Do not hesitate to jump into Discord and see some updates as they happen and meet some other players! Maybe find a gem to join and make some new friends.

~The Collar is digging deep.

notes.title: July Update
notes.content:
It is already July and things are humming along. It was a long June getting this second level to be performant and working the way it should. I am committed to ensuring everything I put out for you works to its optimal level so you can focus on the game and not "what settings do I need to run this?". The second level of the update is getting the finishing polishes done to it now and the third level is already started albeit in its infancy. With three levels, quite a few mechanic changes, some inside bug fixes, and as always, performance increases, I really think you are all going to love this update! Stayed tuned for more as it comes out and make sure you join the Discord to see random dev blog updates when I have time. LOL

~The Collar has piles to pile on...

notes.title: June Update
notes.content:
Ok I admit I am bad at doing updates on a regular basis, but I am trying to do better. Wanted to let everyone know I have been working VERY hard on some really great level additions for the next update. They are coming along very well and I hope we will all get some time in them very soon. I have a small, medium, and large level coming to help continued variety and game play. There is a few new mechanics in this update coming as well, some bug fixes, and some really great optimizations to performance and game play. Even more are some foundations for coming enhancements that are on the roadmap. The game is not stagnant or lost, just only have so much time to balance everything. Maybe I need a staff? 🤣 Hope all is well and you are continuing to have fun with the game. New things are on the horizon even past this update. I truly appreciate the community and the amount of fun that everyone is having and even more to come! And as long as you want more, I will be honored to give you more.

~The Collar is evolving...

notes.title: One Month Update
notes.content:
It has been a little over a month and things are going well! I hope everyone has had a chance to play and enjoy the triumph we have all had a hand in creating. If not, hit me up so we can play some! Check out the Discord #⁠looking-for-a-group! Now that the release is out I started on the next update. There are going to be some new surprises, some QoL items, and big important items like maps and performance improvements. I am excited to deliver the next set of updates to you and to new players!

~The Collar does not sleep.

notes.title: New Release v1.0.2 is LIVE
notes.content:
Just a small update to add a nifty, albeit difficult, achievement to the mix. Also a fix that will make the controller right-stick to not be inverted by default. If you have changed your setting to invert the right-stick because of the previous settings, you will need to change it back.

~The Collar insists on improvements.


v1.0.2 Release Notes

Updates

 Added an achievement called The One


Bug Fixes

 Fixed the default settings of the right-stick on a controller to not be inverted

notes.title: The Collar Release Date
notes.content:
Release Date Announcement

EXCITING, GREAT, and AWESOME news!!!!! This has been 3 years in the making and it is finally here. On February 29th The Collar will be officially released and the hoards (LOL) of people will begin to play! It is exciting and terrifying all at the same time. Thank you everyone for your support, whether morale or actual game testing, I appreciate each and everyone of you for your help. It could not have been done without you. And our journey does not stop at release...oh no. Once the game is released, I can start planning on the next updates. Keep your eyes open for some new features for the release; got to have something new for those who played test builds!!!!

~The Collar is coming February 29, 2024.
